qr.cameraButton.description: Button that starts the camera for QR scanning, on both the check-in and the staff scanners. Names the hardware action, not the product's voice.

qr.closeButton.description: Button that stops the camera, on both QR scanners.

qr.switchCameraButton.description: Button that switches between the front and back cameras, on both QR scanners.

qr.torchButton.description: Button that toggles the phone's flashlight while scanning, on both QR scanners.
